incidents-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: HIGH impact — VeridianSystems (dedicated pool vdp-7, VPC) reporting missing traces and partial log access. Customer reports inability to debug live requests. Paging oncall SRE.
maria (oncall SRE): I'm on it. Short summary pls: are requests failing or just observability gaps?
oliver (VeridianSystems): Mostly observability. App traffic looks normal, but our traces for ~10:42-10:58 UTC are absent and some logs from svc-inference are gated (403 from forwarder). Latency is slightly elevated p95 ~+120ms but requests succeed.
tess (prod-support): Noted customer impact: inability to correlate errors with traces. They've got an active deploy but are pausing further rollouts until tracing restored.
maria (oncall SRE): Thanks. Initial checks: dedicated pool vdp-7 shows normal serving metrics. I see a bunch of 403s in the per-tenant forwarder logs to trace-collector from the VPC forwarder role. Looks like the Veridian tenant's role binding expired during a key rotation window.
sam (eng-runtime): Confirming — aggregator rejected spans from tenant-id "veridian-001" due to missing assume-role permission. Metrics ingestion partitioning is fine; it's the trace stream and S3 log-forwarder that are blocked.
maria (oncall SRE): Action plan: 1) Temporary mitigation — grant ephemeral assume-role for veridian-forwarder so spans can flow to central traces. 2) Start a short-lived proxy in eng-platform to forward spans while we fix IAM. 3) Coordinate with Veridian on consent for keys. 4) Postmortem on role rotation automation.
raj (eng-platform): I can stand up a passthrough proxy in us-east-1 (priv net) to accept spans from vdp-7 and push to the collector using platform creds. Will need an allowlist entry for veridian subnets. Spinning up now.
raj (eng-platform): Command I'm running (for audit):

```
# terraform-ish step (internal)
aws iam attach-role-policy --role-name veridian-forwarder-temp --policy-arn arn:aws:iam::redwood:policy/span-forwarder-temporary
kubectl -n eng-platform run span-proxy-veridian --image=redwood/span-proxy:canary --env "COLLECTOR=https://collector.internal" --expose
```
maria (oncall SRE): Good. tess — please send the customer the short blurb about why we need ephemeral creds and ask for confirmation to proceed. We can't forward Veridian logs to central S3 without consent.
tess (prod-support): On it. Messaging:

"Hi Oliver — we detected the tenant forwarding role expired. To restore traces quickly we can: (A) temporarily attach a platform-managed forwarding role, or (B) have you re-attach the existing role with the updated trust policy. Option A is faster but requires your ok to route spans through a Redwood-managed proxy. Which do you prefer?"
oliver (VeridianSystems): Option A please, we need tracing back ASAP. We approve temporary proxy + ephemeral creds. Please share the audit token once up.
maria (oncall SRE): Raj — once proxy is live, push an ACL so vdp-7 can reach it. Sam — watch the collector for incoming spans and confirm trace IDs show up for recent request ids.
sam (eng-runtime): Watching. I'll tail collector logs and run a small synthetic test against the Veridian tenant to generate a trace.
raj (eng-platform): Proxy is up, ACL added for 10.24.0.0/18 (vdp-7). Endpoint: https://span-proxy-veridian.internal
maria (oncall SRE): Applying temporary assume-role binding now. IAM change (audit):

```
# ephemeral bind
aws iam create-role --role-name veridian-forwarder-temp --assume-role-policy-document file://trust.json
aws iam attach-role-policy --role-name veridian-forwarder-temp --policy-arn arn:aws:iam::redwood:policy/span-forwarder-temporary
# record: change-id=chg-1972109876-01
```
sam (eng-runtime): I see spans arriving from tenant veridian-001 at 10:59:12 UTC. First traces are present. Sampling looks okay. Will validate span continuity for 10:42-10:58 window — we won't get retrospective spans, but live capture is restored.
oliver (VeridianSystems): I can see new traces in our console now, thank you. We still don't have historical traces for the 16 minute window — is there any way to backfill?
tess (prod-support): Short answer: we cannot reconstruct lost ephemeral traces unless the provider cached them. We can check whether any local forwarder buffers were persisted to the VPC S3 before the role expired. Asking ops if there's any buffered files.
sam (eng-runtime): Checked the vdp-7 node buffers — no persisted span archives. Looks like they were only in-memory, so not recoverable. We should flag this as partial observability loss (no data loss of requests; only loss of trace telemetry for that window).
maria (oncall SRE): Incident status: Mitigated — live tracing restored via proxy + temp role. Customer impact: debugging blindspot for 10:42-10:58 UTC, otherwise app functional. Next steps: 1) eng-platform to roll permanent role fix + automated test to detect trust expiry (raj). 2) eng-runtime to add sampling/backpressure safeguards and small persistent buffer for tenant forwarders (sam). 3) prod-support to run customer comms and ETA for follow-up (tess). 4) postmortem owner: maria.
raj (eng-platform): I'll open a PR to pin the trust policy and add a CI check that exercises role assumption every 6 hours. Link PR once created.
sam (eng-runtime): I'll draft a tiny durable buffer that flushes to S3 on disconnect (opt-in per-tenant). Will scope and estimate for the retrospective.
tess (prod-support): Sent customer update: we're keeping the proxy for 1 hour while the permanent fix is deployed, will notify when removed. Oliver acknowledged.
maria (oncall SRE): Great. I'm marking the incident as resolved for paging. Please add notes to the incident channel with the chg-id and link to PRs.
oliver (VeridianSystems): Thanks team. Appreciate the quick help and the temporary route — please keep me in the loop on permanent fixes and the postmortem.
incidents-bot: Incident closed (auto): root=1972109876 severity=high impact=observability_gap mitigated_by=temporary_proxy+ephemeral_role closed_at=1972111200
